summary: American Bitcoin Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-15 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective July 2, 2026. The split was approved by stockholders at the June 22, 2026 annual meeting and authorized by the board. All shares were reduced proportionally, with fractional shares cashed out. No change in percentage ownership or voting power. Outstanding shares dropped from ~1.09B to ~73M. This is a routine capital structure adjustment to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance, not a special situation. No deal terms apply; no premium, advisor, or strategic event.
